name: columnbridge
description: Local AI column matching for CSV imports, with explicit review before renaming.

scripts.demo: node bin/columnbridge.js match --input examples/contacts.csv --schema examples/contact-schema.json --out examples/report.json
scripts.demo:offline: node bin/columnbridge.js match --input examples/contacts.csv --schema examples/contact-schema.json --out examples/report-offline.json --offline
